LESSON: HADITH ON GRATITUDE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Greetings (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the le
Topic 2.4: Hadith on Gratitude

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Hadith on Gratitude
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should one be grateful to other people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation

Teach
• Today’s focus: read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation” using a school example.
• Model B for “read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 2: practise gratitude in day-to- day life

Teach
• Today’s focus: practise gratitude in day-to- day life.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “practise gratitude in day-to- day life” using a school example.
• Model B for “practise gratitude in day-to- day life” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "practise gratitude in day-to- day life" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
• Model 2: practise gratitude in day-to- day life

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
2. Practise: practise gratitude in day-to- day life

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Hadith on Gratitude.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one be grateful to other people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
• practise gratitude in day-to- day life

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
